title: Missing font resources bypass semantic extracted-text budget

trigger.description: A PDF content stream contains a long Tj text operand but no font resource. pypdf returns an empty string from extract_text(), while the raw decoded content stream still contains the text operation.

pre_fix_behavior: The semantic extracted-text counter remained at zero, so the document could pass the text budget despite carrying a long text operand.

post_fix_behavior.description: The parser enforces both semantic extracted length and decoded content-stream text-operation bytes.

security_invariant: Parser budgets must combine semantic extracted length, raw text-operation bytes, decoded byte budget, and execution resource limits.
